out.other_title: Weak-to-strong learning problem and weak supervisor / strong student setup
out.rationale: Burns et al. define the weak-to-strong setup: a small model finetuned on ground truth produces weak labels on held-out data, and a strong pretrained model finetuned on them is the strong student. Lang, Huang and Li keep this pipeline but finetune the weak model with debate arguments from the large model appended as context, and use an ensemble of such weak models to label data for the strong student.
out.scope: proposed EXTENDS: weak-supervisor-to-strong-student pipelines, extended by giving the weak supervisor debate transcripts from a strong model

text: The paper combines scalable oversight with weak-to-strong generalization by fine-tuning a small weak model on ground-truth labels with debate arguments from a large strong model as added context, then fine-tuning the strong model on the weak model's labels. The authors report that debate helps the weak model extract trustworthy information from the untrustworthy strong model, that an ensemble of weak models makes better use of long debate arguments, and that the combination gives better alignment on the OpenAI weak-to-strong NLP benchmarks.
title: Debate transcripts from a strong model help train a better weak supervisor
